title: ci: a weekly merge-queue duration reading against a 22-minute median budget and a 32-minute p90 alarm, filing a speed-up card when over
body:
review-split thread · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYzM6act7DgRZuPrxu

Source: maintainer — Warren, 2026-11-19, review-split discussion thread: 03:16Z 「以上都同意」 (CI speed budget for objectstack; 「变慢两成非常大了」 rejected a 20% allowance); 04:24Z 「1+2+4」, point 2 as amended by the review: budget = median 22 min, alarm = p90 32 min, measured weekly by a script that files a speed-up card when over; a PR's own before/after reading is advisory and never blocks a merge.

Filing gate: ③ a task the maintainer dispatched. Child of epic #35205.

Grade: p2 · area:fleet · Task · fleet machinery, no product surface

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：每周自动量一次合并队列耗时（中位、九成、失败率），超过 22 分钟中位或 32 分钟九成就自动开一张提速卡。
- 为什么：你 11-19 定的 CI 速度预算；现在没人盯趋势，变慢没人知道。
- 最坏：量错会多开或漏开提速卡；不挡任何合并，可随时撤。
- 需要你做的：无（改 workflow 与 AGENTS.md，到时请你批）。

## Baseline

merge_group runs 2026-11-17..19: 176 all-green head SHAs, first start to last end over the queue workflows (waiting for a runner included), p50 21.7 min, p90 31.9 min, max 34.5 min.

## What changes

1. **`scripts/ci/queue-duration.mjs`** (new, read-only): reads the last 7 days of `merge_group` runs of the workflows that run on the queue, groups them by head SHA, and for all-green SHAs measures first start to last end. Prints p50, p90, max, sample size, the queue failure rate (SHAs with any red run), and the five slowest jobs on the critical path. Takes `--repo <owner/name>` and `--since`; `--json` for the workflow. `--self-test` per AGENTS.md "Writing a --self-test" (battery names, floor, handshake), offline on fixtures.
2. **`scripts/ci/queue-budget.json`** (new): `budgetMedianMinutes: 22`, `alarmP90Minutes: 32`, the baseline above with its window, and the list of queue workflow names. Changing a number is the maintainer's call (say so in the file and in the script header).
3. **A weekly scheduled job** (a job in `fleet-patrols.yml` beside `governed-merges-audit`, or its own workflow if the patrol pins make that cleaner): runs the script for objectstack; when the 7-day median exceeds the budget or the p90 exceeds the alarm, files or refreshes ONE deduplicated card (fixed title prefix + plain-text body marker, the `scheduled-full-run-card` pattern; labels on create only: `tooling`, `area:fleet`, `domain:devx`, `priority:p2`, `pm:queue`, issue type Task). Writes nothing on `pull_request`. Also prints hotcrm's queue reading (`--repo objectstack-ai/hotcrm`, public) to the run summary, report-only, no card.
4. **`AGENTS.md`**, Build & Test: one sentence that the merge queue has a speed budget held in `scripts/ci/queue-budget.json`, read weekly, over budget files a speed-up card; a PR that changes CI or adds a gate reports the affected job's before/after median as advisory.

## Done when

- `node scripts/ci/queue-duration.mjs --self-test` green; a live dry run on the last 7 days prints a reading close to the baseline (cite it with the commit it was taken on).
- The scheduled job runs on `workflow_dispatch` without writing on a PR event; the de-dup holds (second run refreshes, never files twice).
